_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::brownian_dynamics#1, confirmed by execution. BROWNIAN DYNAMICS/KT has default_value 0.0 in 4C's input spec and BROWNDYNPROB: true does not imply a temperature. Upstream beam3r_line2_backweuler_browndyn_periodic_rve_dirich_element.4C.yaml is exactly that configuration — BROWNDYNPROB true, VISCOSITY set, no KT — and it is a purely deterministic run: node 2's transverse displacements come out at 1.79e-16 and 1.19e-16, machine zero, which the deck result-tests as zero. Adding KT makes the kicks appear at once (dispx 1.97729908169594938e-02, dispy -1.19525609708355449e-02) and all three tests fail. So a deck with BROWNDYNPROB true and no KT looks like a Brownian simulation, runs like one, contains no thermal physics at all, and 4C never mentions it. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: take the contrast away: leave the second arm without KT too. Both arms are then the same deterministic run, the thermal displacements never appear, WITHKT_FAILURES becomes 0 and EXIT_WITHKT becomes 0 — the fixture must go red.
